Riverbend Elementary is a fictional public school with 400 students and a caring staff. We are looking for an Education Assistant to support students in a grade 2 classroom. You will work closely with the classroom teacher to support a student with autism, help small reading groups, and supervise recess and lunch. You will help students follow their individual education plans, keep simple daily notes on progress, and stay calm and patient when a child is upset. Experience working with children is required, for example in childcare, coaching or a summer camp. An Education Assistant certificate is preferred but not required. You must have a clear criminal record check. This is a 10-month position, Monday to Friday, 8:30 to 3:00, with paid professional development days.
